mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and potentially CYP2C9, reducing naproxen metabolism and increasing NSAID exposure; concurrent use also increases GI bleeding risk and may reduce anticonvulsant efficacy.
action: Monitor for increased naproxen adverse effects (GI bleeding, renal dysfunction); consider alternative analgesic or gastroprotection; assess seizure control as NSAIDs may lower seizure threshold.
